subject: Re: Trendi Labs — demo intake, use case details & slot request
messages:
From: Sasha Venkataraman <sasha@trendi.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-18 09:12 PDT
Subject: Interested — Demo request (Trendi Labs)

Hi Rishi,

We signed up for a trial earlier today and I wanted to see if we could schedule a short demo to review embedding pipelines and cost/latency impact. Quick context: Trendi is building a search/recap feature on top of customer chat history — mostly embedding-based retrieval + a lightweight reranker.

Rough numbers: ~12M monthly messages, expect active subset of ~200k queries/month initially, peak QPS ~35, average request window ~512 tokens, embeddings are 1536-d. Timeline: pilot in 6–8 weeks, production in ~3 months.

Questions we have up front: do you support dedicated capacity for predictable latency? What does typical inference cost and autoscale look like for an embeddings-heavy workload? Any SSO/SSO metadata we should prepare?

Would appreciate a 30-min intro next week. I’m PT (PDT).

Thanks,
Sasha
Head of ML, Trendi Labs
[sasha@trendi.com]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Venkataraman <sasha@trendi.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-18 09:40 PDT
Subject: Re: Interested — Demo request (Trendi Labs)

Hi Sasha — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the context. This is exactly the kind of embeddings-heavy workload we’ve helped a few customers with. Quick answers up front: yes, Redwood Dedicated can give you pinned GPU capacity and predictable p99 latency; we also have cost/throughput guidance for 1k–10k QPS ranges and autoscale bursts.

Before we lock a slot, a couple of quick qual questions so the demo is focused and we can bring the right engineer(s):
- Is the 200k queries/month estimate steady across weeks or concentrated in certain dayparts (e.g., business hours)?
- For the 1536-d embeddings, are you planning on batched offline indexing only, or will you be generating embeddings at write time too?
- Any regulatory/data residency constraints (EU-only, HIPAA, etc.)?
- Do you anticipate needing SAML SSO for the console or a Private (VPC) deployment in pilot?

I’m looping Mina (SDR) to propose three demo times in PDT — she’ll send over options and a Calendly if that’s easier. I’ve attached a short one-pager that covers Dedicated vs Hosted and a checklist we usually ask customers to fill out before demo.

Attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Growth — Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf]

Thanks Mina — Tue 2028-06-20 13:00–13:30 PDT works for us.

Quick answers to your clarifying bullets:
- Embeddings: majority are precomputed during nightly jobs, but ~20% of writes will generate embeddings at write time. Typical generation latency is ~120–250ms depending on model.
- 35 QPS is read/query traffic only; writes are much lower (avg 1–2 qps).
- No HIPAA/EU-only constraints for pilot; we may need EU residency later but pilot will be in US.
- We will need SAML SSO for the admin console and likely a Private deployment conversation if pilot goes well.

We’ll have our infra lead Tim O'Leary join the call (cc’d). Can you send a calendar invite and include a Sec/Network checklist link for Tim to review?

Looking forward to the call — Sasha
Head of ML, Trendi Labs
[sasha@trendi.com]
